systems: Foundry core primitives; native initiative depends on installed system. Source audit baseline Foundry14.368/dnd5e6.0.3, not new live acceptance.
preconditions: Current reviewed catalog grants for any non-core action
minimum_reads: Discover/load current combat list/get/create/add/initiative/start schemas only when needed

input.combatantIds: optional array; only missing eligible participants

steps: Resolve scene and participants; ask only ambiguous consequential decisions.
Read relevant combat state; repeated request reuses matching encounter rather than creates another.
Create only when absent and currently granted; add only missing actor/token identities.
Roll only initiative still missing. Stop for required player roll/choice; explicit reroll/new encounter is a separate intent.
Start only an unstarted combat; starting does not itself establish initiative was rolled.
Report confirmed returned order/round/turn/current combatant. Uncertain result requires inspection and prevents blind retry.
evidence: Corresponding completed durable receipt and authoritative combat state; raw primitive response is not proof of an entire workflow.
round_trips: Existing primitives: reads plus up to create, N adds, initiative, start; dynamic catalog search/load/execute may add trips. No measured reduction or one-call guarantee.
gaps: No single bounded stable-operation start coordinator
Raw MCP primitive existence does not establish AI catalog permission
Native player-choice/manual roll behavior must be checked per system

Descriptor says omitted IDs roll missing initiative, but native handler calls rollAll; always supply a nonempty explicit missing-ID list, and skip call when none missing. Never pass omitted or empty IDs as a missing-only guarantee.
